preprocessing: ShapeTransform and PCA/whitening fitted on training rows only per fold
kernel: RBF on whitened image PCA; distances computed by independent einsum, no BLAS matmul
selection: Validation macroF1 then balanced accuracy then smaller C/gamma
unit: Average OVR decision scores of the two repeats per location; scores are not probabilities
limitations: Retrospective same-study grouped CV, previously observed test positions
No annotated length or boundary metadata input
